The Generals, as told to you by Vaelan, are: War Master Voone of the Smolderthorn; Highlord Omokk of the Spirestone; and Overlord Wyrmthalak  of the Bloodaxe.

4743.name: Seal of Ascension
objective: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh. Find the ancient drake, Emberstrife and beat him without mercy until his will is broken.

It is at that moment which you must place the Unforged Seal of Ascension before the great beast. You must then be quick to use the Orb of Draconic Energy on his weakened form and claim dominion over his mental faculties. Control the beast and force the Flames of the Black Dragonflight upon the Unforged Seal of Ascension!

4761.name: Thundris Windweaver
objective: Speak with Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

4762.name: The Cliffspring River
objective: Travel north of Auberdine to the first waterfall along the Cliffspring River and draw a sample from the pool there.
Return to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine with the Cliffspring River Sample.

4763.name: The Blackwood Corrupted
objective: Fill the Empty Cleansing Bowl at the Auberdine Moonwell.
Gather a sample of fruit, nut, and grain from the northern Blackwood furbolg camps.
Mix the bowl and place it near the bonfire closest to the Cliffspring River at the northern camp, thus summoning the satyr corruptor.
Take the Talisman of Corruption and bring it to Thundris Windweaver in Auberdine.

4764.name: Doomrigger's Clasp
objective: Bring Doomrigger's Clasp to Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

4765.name: Delivery to Ridgewell
objective: Bring Ridgewell's Crate to Remington Ridgewell in Stormwind.

4766.name: Mayara Brightwing
objective: Speak with Mayara Brightwing in the Burning Steppes.

4767.name: Wind Rider
objective: Bring 10 Highperch Wyvern Eggs to Elu in Freewind Post.

4768.name: The Darkstone Tablet
objective: Bring the Darkstone Tablet to Shadow Mage Vivian Lagrave in Kargath.

4769.name: Vivian Lagrave and the Darkstone Tablet
objective: Speak with Shadowmage Vivian Lagrave.

4770.name: Homeward Bound
objective: Escort Pao'ka Swiftmountain from Highperch, and then talk to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post.

4771.name: Dawn's Gambit
objective: Place Dawn's Gambit in the Viewing Room of the Scholomance.  Defeat Vectus, then return to Betina Bigglezink.

4781.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objective: Bring a Gold Bar to Xizk Goodstitch in Stranglethorn Vale.

4782.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objective: Return to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4783.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objective: Bring 10 Vials of Hatefury Blood and 1 Lesser Infernal Stone to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4784.name: Components for the Enchanted Gold Bloodrobe
objective: Bring some Fine Gold Thread, 2 Smoldering Coals, and a Soul Shard to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4786.name: The Completed Robe
objective: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete your robe and then speak to her again.

4787.name: The Ancient Egg
objective: Bring the Ancient Egg to Yeh'kinya in Tanaris.

4788.name: The Final Tablets
objective: Bring the Fifth and Sixth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

4808.name: Felnok Steelspring
objective: Give Tinkee's Letter to Felnok Steelspring.

4809.name: Chillwind Horns
objective: Bring 8 Uncracked Chillwind Horns to Felnok Steelspring.

4810.name: Return to Tinkee
objective: Bring Felnok's Package to Tinkee Steamboil in the Burning Steppes.

4811.name: The Red Crystal
objective: Travel east of Auberdine and look for a large, red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain range.  Report back what you find to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

4812.name: As Water Cascades
objective: Fill the Empty Water Tube at the Auberdine moonwell, and then investigate the red crystal along Darkshore's eastern mountain wall.

4813.name: The Fragments Within
objective: Report back what you have found to Sentinel Glynda Nal'Shea in Auberdine.

4821.name: Alien Egg
objective: Return the Alien Egg to Hagar Lightninghoof in Freewind Post.

4841.name: Pacify the Centaur
objective: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

4842.name: Strange Sources
objective: Follow Donova Snowden's instructions, then report back.

4861.name: Enraged Wildkin
objective: Locate Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked camp and supplies in southern Winterspring.

4862.name: En-Ay-Es-Tee-Why
objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 15 Spire Spider Eggs for Kibler.
By the sound of it, these eggs could be found near spiders.

4863.name: Enraged Wildkin
objective: Find Jaron Stoneshaper's wrecked wagon.

4864.name: Enraged Wildkin
objective: Pick up Jaron's Supplies from the snow, then find the wildkin that stole the amulet Jaron spoke of.
Bring Jaron's Supplies and the Blue-feathered Amulet to Jaron Stoneshaper at the lodge in Winterspring.

4865.name: Serpent Wild
objective: Report your findings to Motega Firemane.

4866.name: Mother's Milk
objective: In the heart of Blackrock Spire you will find Mother Smolderweb. Engage her and get her to poison you. Chances are good that you will have to kill her as well. Return to Ragged John when you are poisoned so that he can 'milk' you.

4867.name: Urok Doomhowl
objective: Read Warosh's Scroll.  Bring Warosh's Mojo to Warosh.

4881.name: Assassination Plot
objective: Warn Kanati Greycloud at Whitereach Post of the plot to kill him.

4882.name: Guarding Secrets
objective: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Trull Failbane at Bloodvenom Post.

4883.name: Guarding Secrets
objective: Take the Blue-feathered Necklace to Nara Wildmane.

4901.name: Guardians of the Altar
objective: Protect Ranshalla while she attempts to reactivate the Altar of Elune. Report your findings to Erelas Ambersky in Rut'theran Village.

4902.name: Wildkin of Elune
objective: Speak with Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus.

4903.name: Warlord's Command
objective: Slay Highlord Omokk, War Master Voone, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Recover Important Blackrock Documents. Return to Warlord Goretooth in Kargath when the mission has been accomplished.

4904.name: Free at Last
objective: Escort Lakota Windsong from the Darkcloud Pinnacle, and then talk to Thalia Amberhide at Freewind Post.

4906.name: Further Corruption
objective: Eridan Bluewind in Felwood wants you to kill 8 Jadefire Hellcallers, 8 Jadefire Betrayers, 8 Jadefire Tricksters, and Xavaric. Return to Eridan when the task is completed.

4907.name: Tinkee Steamboil
objective: Speak with Tinkee Steamboil.

4921.name: Lost in Battle
objective: Find Mankrik's wife and then return to him in the Crossroads.

4941.name: Eitrigg's Wisdom
objective: Speak with Eitrigg in Orgrimmar. When you have discussed matters with Eitrigg, seek council from Thrall.
You recall having seen Eitrigg in Thrall's chamber.

4961.name: Cleansing of the Orb of Orahil
objective: Kill the Demon of the Orb, then speak with Tabetha.

4962.name: Shard of a Felhound
objective: Take the Felhas Ruby and use it on one of the Felhounds found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Felhas Ruby and the Imprisoned Felhound Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4963.name: Shard of an Infernal
objective: Take the Infus Emerald and use it on one of the Infernals found in Desolace. After successful, bring the Infus Emerald and the Imprisoned Infernal Spirit back to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4964.name: The Completed Orb of Dar'Orahil
objective: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Dar'Orahil and then speak to her again.

4965.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
objective: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4966.name: Protect Kanati Greycloud
objective: Protect Kanati Greycloud from the centaur attack.

4967.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
objective: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4968.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
objective: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4969.name: Knowledge of the Orb of Orahil
objective: Speak to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4971.name: A Matter of Time
objective: Use the Temporal Displacer near one of Andorhal's silos and uncover Temporal Parasites.
Slay 15 Temporal Parasites, and then return the Temporal Displacer to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4972.name: Counting Out Time
objective: Locate 5 Andorhal Watches, found in lockboxes amongst the rubble of the city.  Return with them to Chromie in the Andorhal Inn, Western Plaguelands.

4974.name: For The Horde!
objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay Warchief Rend Blackhand. Take his head and return to Orgrimmar.

4975.name: The Completed Orb of Noh'Orahil
objective: Wait for Menara Voidrender to complete the Orb of Noh'Orahil and then speak to her again.

4976.name: Returning the Cleansed Orb
objective: Return the Cleansed Infernal Orb to Menara Voidrender in the Barrens.

4981.name: Operative Bijou
objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find out what happened to Bijou.

4982.name: Bijou's Belongings
objective: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. You recall her mentioning that she stashed them on the bottom floor of the city.

4983.name: Bijou's Reconnaissance Report
objective: Take Bijou's Reconnaissance Report back to Grandmaster Lexlort in Kargath.

4984.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
objective: Destroy 8 Diseased Wolves, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4985.name: The Wildlife Suffers Too
objective: Destroy 8 Diseased Grizzlies, and then return to Mulgris Deepriver at the Writhing Haunt, Western Plaguelands.

4986.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
objective: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Darnassus is the next step the tauren druid sought.  Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

4987.name: Glyphed Oaken Branch
objective: Based on the magic enchanted within the Glyphed Oaken Branch, its delivery to the Cenarion Circle in Thunder Bluff is the next step the tauren druid sought.  Seek one of the druids there for assistance.

5001.name: Bijou's Belongings
objective: Find Bijou's Belongings and return them to her. Good luck!

5002.name: Message to Maxwell
objective: Travel to the Burning Steppes and give Bijou's Information to Marshal Maxwell.

5021.name: Better Late Than Never
objective: The ramblings of the ghostly woman indicated that she needed a package delivered.  She claimed that it was where her horse was.  As to where the horse is or where the package was to be delivered - the ghost remains incomprehensible.

5022.name: Better Late Than Never
objective: Check with the Royal Factors of Stormwind to learn the whereabouts of an Emma Felstone.  There is usually a census officer located in City Hall.

5023.name: Better Late Than Never
objective: Check with the Royal Overseers of the Undercity to learn the whereabouts of a Jeremiah Felstone.  There is usually a census officer located near guild and tabard registration.

5041.name: Supplies for the Crossroads
objective: Find and return Crossroads' Supply Crates to Thork in the Barrens.

5047.name: Pip Quickwit, At Your Service!
objective: Talk to Malyfous Darkhammer in Everlook.

5048.name: Good Natured Emma
objective: Find Ol' Emma in Stormwind and see if she is in fact Emma Felstone.  If she is, then perhaps she'd like the package Janice Felstone made for her.

5049.name: The Jeremiah Blues
objective: Find Jeremiah Payson in the Undercity and see if he is in fact Jeremiah Felstone.  If he is, then perhaps he'd like the package Janice Felstone made for him.

5050.name: Good Luck Charm
objective: Return to Janice Felstone in Western Plaguelands her Good Luck Half-Charm.

5051.name: Two Halves Become One
objective: Locate the other half of the Good Luck Charm somewhere on the Felstone Farm in Western Plaguelands and reassemble it.
Give the Good Luck Charm to Janice Felstone on the Felstone Farm, Western Plaguelands.

5052.name: Blood Shards of Agamaggan
objective: Bring a Blood Shard to Mangletooth in Camp Taurajo in the Barrens.
Collect more Blood Shards if you want him to bless you with Agamaggan's power.

5054.name: Ursius of the Shardtooth
objective: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Ursius.

5055.name: Brumeran of the Chillwind
objective: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to kill Brumeran.

5056.name: Shy-Rotam
objective: Storm Shadowhoof at Everlook in Winterspring wants you to defeat Shy-Rotam.

5057.name: Past Endeavors
objective: Bring Storm Shadowhoof's Marker to Melor Stonehoof in Thunder Bluff.

5058.name: Mrs. Dalson's Diary
objective: A diary with yellowing pages lies open to the last entry:

"I don't know what's going to happen now that Harold's turned.  It took everything out of me to drag him into the only place I could find that'd lock him up tight and hold him.  I hid the key on me, and I pray it works...
I hope I can get out of here, but I need money to do that.  Our stuff's all in the cabinet I think... and now that I think about it, doesn't Harold keep the key on him?
I'll rest on it, I'm dead tired now."

5060.name: Locked Away
objective: An extremely sturdy cabinet stands before you, securely fastened shut by a built-in lock.  The front of the cabinet is deeply scratched and marked.  This could be surmised as being from numerous and violent failed attempts to reveal whatever secrets the cabinet currently obfuscates from view.
If you are going to open this cabinet, you will need to find the key.

5061.name: Aquatic Form
objective: Return to Darnassus and show Mathrengyl Bearwalker the Pendant of the Sea Lion.

5062.name: Sacred Fire
objective: Gather 10 bushels of Incendia Agave, and then consult Magatha Grimtotem on Elder Rise in Thunderbluff.

5064.name: Grimtotem Spying
objective: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.

5065.name: The Lost Tablets of Mosh'aru
objective: Bring the Third and Fourth Mosh'aru Tablets to Prospector Ironboot in Tanaris.

5066.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objective: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist.  His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5081.name: Maxwell's Mission
objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy War Master Voone, Highlord Omokk, and Overlord Wyrmthalak. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

5082.name: Threat of the Winterfall
objective: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to kill 8 Winterfall Pathfinders, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 Winterfall Totemics.

5083.name: Winterfall Firewater
objective: Bring the Empty Firewater Flask to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5084.name: Falling to Corruption
objective: Search the Deadwood furbolg camp in northern Felwood for a clue.

5085.name: Mystery Goo
objective: Report back to Donova Snowden with your findings.

5086.name: Toxic Horrors
objective: Collect 3 Toxic Horror Droplets for Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5087.name: Winterfall Runners
objective: Find the Winterfall Runners and stop them from delivering their shipment to Winterfall Village.

5088.name: Arikara
objective: Slay Arikara. Bring her remains and the Incendia Powder to Motega Firemane in Whitereach Post as proof of your deed.

5089.name: General Drakkisath's Command
objective: Take General Drakkisath's Command to Marshal Maxwell in Burning Steppes.

5090.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objective: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist.  His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5091.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objective: Seek out Commander Ashlam Valorfist.  His base camp is located at Chillwind Camp, north of the Alterac Mountains.

5092.name: Clear the Way
objective: Kill 10 Skeletal Flayers and 10 Slavering Ghouls in Sorrow Hill.
Return to Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5093.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objective: Seek out High Executor Derrington.  His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

5094.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objective: Seek out High Executor Derrington.  His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glade and the Undercity.

5095.name: A Call to Arms: The Plaguelands!
objective: Seek out High Executor Derrington.  His base camp is located at the Bulwark, east of Tirisfal Glades and the Undercity.

5096.name: Scarlet Diversions
objective: Proceed to the Scarlet Crusade's base camp between Felstone Field and Dalson's Tears and destroy their command tent.
Place the Scourge banner at the camp, and then return to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5097.name: All Along the Watchtowers
objective: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to Commander Ashlam Valorfist in Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5098.name: All Along the Watchtowers
objective: Using the Beacon Torch, mark each tower in Andorhal; you will need to stand in the doorway of the tower to successfully mark it.
Once all four towers are marked, return the Beacon Torch to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.

5102.name: General Drakkisath's Demise
objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and destroy General Drakkisath. Return to Marshal Maxwell when the job is done.

5103.name: Hot Fiery Death
objective: Someone in this world must know what to do with these gauntlets. Good luck!

5121.name: High Chief Winterfall
objective: Donova Snowden in Winterspring wants you to defeat High Chief Winterfall.

5123.name: The Final Piece
objective: Bring the Crudely-written Log to Donova Snowden in Winterspring.

5124.name: Fiery Plate Gauntlets
objective: Bring Malyfous Darkhammer 6 Enchanted Thorium Bars, 2 Essence of Fire, and 4 Star Rubies. You will also need to turn in your Unfired Plate Gauntlets.

5125.name: Aurius' Reckoning
objective: <name>, I am dying... but my soul is saved.  For that, I owe you more than words can say.  Please, take this... and fight on, brave <class>!

5126.name: Lorax's Tale
objective: Speak with Lorax. Listen to what he has to say.

5127.name: The Demon Forge
objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and find Goraluk Anvilcrack. Slay him and then use the Blood Stained Pike upon his corpse. After his soul has been siphoned, the pike will be Soul Stained.
You must also find the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate.
Return both the Soul Stained Pike and the Unforged Rune Covered Breastplate to Lorax in Winterspring.

5128.name: Words of the High Chief
objective: Take the Crudely-written Log to Kelek Skykeeper in southern Felwood.

5141.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
objective: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Peter Galen in Azshara.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5142.name: Little Pamela
objective: Find Pamela Redpath.

5143.name: Tribal Leatherworking
objective: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Caryssia Moonhunter in Feralas.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5144.name: Elemental Leatherworking
objective: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Sarah Tanner in Searing Gorge.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5145.name: Dragonscale Leatherworking
objective: Bring 2 Tough Scorpid Breastplates, 2 Tough Scorpid Gloves, and 10 Worn Dragonscales to Thorkaf Dragoneye in the Badlands.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Dragonscale Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Elemental Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5146.name: Elemental Leatherworking
objective: Bring 2 Heart of Fire, 2 Globe of Water, 2 Core of Earth, and 2 Breath of Wind to Brumn Winterhoof in the Arathi Mountains.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Elemental Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Tribal Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5147.name: WANTED: Arnak Grimtotem
objective: Slay Arnak Grimtotem and bring proof of your deed to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

5148.name: Tribal Leatherworking
objective: Bring a Wild Leather Vest and a Wild Leather Helmet to Se'Jib in Stranglethorn Vale.
Completing this quest will give you access to the Tribal Leatherworking arts.
The completion of this quest will prevent you from learning Dragonscale Leatherworking and Elemental Leatherworking; be sure this is the path you wish to follow before doing so.

5149.name: Pamela's Doll
objective: Find Pamela's doll.

5151.name: Hypercapacitor Gizmo
objective: Slay the beast and bring back the Hypercapacitor Gizmo and Panther Cage Key to Wizlo Bearingshiner.

5152.name: Auntie Marlene
objective: Speak with Marlene, south of the Ruins of Andorhal.

5153.name: A Strange Historian
objective: Bring Joseph's Wedding Ring to Chromie.

5154.name: The Annals of Darrowshire
objective: Bring the Annals of Darrowshire to Chromie in Andorhal.

5155.name: Forces of Jaedenar
objective: Enter Jaedenar and slay 4 Jaedenar Hounds, 4 Jaedenar Guardsmen, 6 Jaedenar Adepts, and 6 Jaedenar Cultists before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5156.name: Verifying the Corruption
objective: Seek out and destroy 2 Entropic Beasts and 2 Entropic Horrors while exploring Shatter Scar Vale. After checking to see if the craters there are still filled with corrupt fel water, return to Taronn Redfeather in Felwood.

5157.name: Collection of the Corrupt Water
objective: Take the Empty Canteen to the Moon Well in the center of Jaedenar and fill it before returning to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5158.name: Seeking Spiritual Aid
objective: Take the Corrupt Moon Well Water to Islen Waterseer in the Barrens.

5159.name: Cleansed Water Returns to Felwood
objective: Take the Purified Moon Well Water to Greta Mosshoof in Felwood.

5160.name: The Matron Protectorate
objective: Travel to Winterspring and find Haleh. Give her Awbee's scale.

5161.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
objective: Speak with Haleh if you wish to continue.

5162.name: Wrath of the Blue Flight
objective: Speak with Jeziba in the Plaguelands. He resides in Andorhal.

5163.name: Are We There, Yeti?
objective: Take Umi's Mechanical Yeti and scare her friends with it:

Legacki in Everlook (Winterspring)
Sprinkle in Gadgetzan (Tanaris)
Quixxil in Marshal's Refuge (Un'Goro Crater)
When you are done, bring the Mechanical Yeti back to Umi.

5164.name: Catalogue of the Wayward
objective: Read from the Catalogue of the Wayward.

5165.name: Dousing the Flames of Protection
objective: Using the Purified Moon Well Water, douse the flames of the four braziers of protection within Shadow Hold in Felwood, then return to Greta Mosshoof in the Emerald Sanctuary.

5166.name: Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight
objective: To forge the Breastplate of the Chromatic Flight, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
10 Frayed Abomination Stitchings.

5167.name: Legplates of the Chromatic Defier
objective: To forge the Legplates of the Chromatic Defier, you will be required to bring the following items to Jeziba the 'Sculptor':
1 Chromatic Carapace.
10 Brilliant Chromatic Scales.
10 Blood of Heroes.
5 Skin of Shadow.

5168.name: Heroes of Darrowshire
objective: Bring Davil's Libram and Redpath's Shield to Carlin Redpath.

5181.name: Villains of Darrowshire
objective: Bring the Skull of Horgus and the Shattered Sword of Marduk to Carlin Redpath at Light's Hope Chapel.

5202.name: A Strange Red Key
objective: Search through Jaedenar to discover what the Blood Red Key is used for.

5203.name: Rescue From Jaedenar
objective: Escort Arko'narin to where Lightforge and her equipment are being held, and then protect her as you escape Shadow Hold. Afterwards, seek out Jessir Moonbow in Felwood to let her know what's happened to her friends.

5204.name: Retribution of the Light
objective: Return to Jaedenar and kill the succubus Rakaiah before finding the Remains of Trey Lightforge.

5206.name: Marauders of Darrowshire
objective: Bring 5 Resonating Skulls and the Mystic Crystal to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5210.name: Brother Carlin
objective: Bring the Extended Annals of Darrowshire to Carlin Redpath in Eastern Plaguelands.

5211.name: Defenders of Darrowshire
objective: Free 15 Darrowshire Spirits and return to Carlin Redpath.

5212.name: The Flesh Does Not Lie
objective: Recover 20 Plagued Flesh Samples from Stratholme and return them to Betina Bigglezink. You suspect that any creature in Stratholme would have said flesh sample.

5213.name: The Active Agent
objective: Travel to Stratholme and search the ziggurats. Find and return new Scourge Data to Betina Bigglezink.

5214.name: The Great Ezra Grimm
objective: Find Ezra Grimm's smoke shop in Stratholme and recover a box of Grimm's Premium Tobacco. Return to Smokey LaRue when the job is done.

5215.name: The Scourge Cauldrons
objective: Speak with High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Point, Western Plaguelands.

5216.name: Target: Felstone Field
objective: Go to Felstone Field in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there.  It may have a key that will allow access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Felstone Field Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5217.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
objective: Bring the Filled Felstone Field Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5219.name: Target: Dalson's Tears
objective: Go to Dalson's Tears in Western Plaguelands to locate and defeat the Cauldron Lord present there, and use its key to gain access to the cauldron.  You must have the Empty Dalson's Tears Bottle with you to secure a sample of the poisons used inside the cauldron.

5220.name: Return to Chillwind Camp
objective: Bring the Filled Dalson's Tears Bottle to High Priestess MacDonnell at Chillwind Camp, Western Plaguelands.

5882.name: Salve via Hunting
objective: Possessing a Cenarion beacon allows one to see a corrupted soul shard on those tainted beasts that are put down for the greater good.  I grind shards into a usable reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve.  We will use that salve to turn corrupted plants into healthy ones again.
In exchange for these shards, I will give you some Cenarion plant salves I have already prepared.

5883.name: Salve via Mining
objective: If you possess a Cenarion beacon while mining in Felwood, you will be able to see tainted vitriol that corrupts a vein of raw metal.  I know how to purify that vitriol and turn it into a reagent that goes into making Cenarion plant salve.  You will then use that salve on plants you find in the wild that need saving.
If you have collected any tainted vitriol, I'll give you some Cenarion plant salve I have already prepared.

5884.name: Salve via Gathering
objective: A Cenarion beacon allows a seasoned herbalist to spot insidious fel creep - a malfeasant product of Felwood's corruption.  My work here has taught me the knowledge of purifying fel creep into a cleansing reagent... used in what we now refer to as Cenarion plant salve.
When you gather herbs in Felwood, you should encounter the fel creep so long as you have the beacon.  In exchange for what you bring to me, I will give you pre-made Cenarion plant salve.

5885.name: Salve via Skinning
objective: A Cenarion beacon will allow a well-trained skinner to spot patches of tainted skin from bounty gathered in Felwood.  I convert these seemingly useless patches into a thick paste that serves as a quickening agent for Cenarion plant salve.  When you skin your kills here in Felwood, be sure to have a beacon on you!
When you collect tainted patches, bring them to me and I will give you some Cenarion plant salves that I have already made.

5886.name: Salve via Disenchanting
objective: The power of a disenchanted magical item is felt by the essence it creates.  I've devised a way to turn raw essence used by enchanters into a suitable reagent for creating Cenarion plant salve.  You don't need a Cenarion beacon for this; any suitably disenchanted item that yields lesser nether essences will work.
I just need a single lesser nether essence; in exchange, I will give you Cenarion plant salves.  The essence is extremely potent - a little definitely goes a long way!

6390.name: A Plague Upon Thee
objective: Release the Plagueland Termites in the Northridge Lumber Mill, then return with the Barrel of Plagueland Termites to Mickey Levine at the Bulwark in Tirisfal Glades.

6391.name: Ride to Ironforge
objective: Buy a gryphon to Ironforge from the gryphon master Thorgrum Borrelson, then bring Brock's List to Golnir Bouldertoe in Ironforge.

6392.name: Return to Brock
objective: Buy a gryphon to Thelsamar from the gryphon master Gryth Thurden, then bring the Honorary Picks to Brock Stoneseeker in Thelsamar.

6393.name: Elemental War
objective: Bring 10 Incendrites to Tsunaman at Sun Rock Retreat.

6394.name: Thazz'ril's Pick
objective: Bring Thazz'ril's Pick to Foreman Thazz'ril.

6395.name: Marla's Last Wish
objective: Bring Samuel Fipps' Remains to Marla's Grave, then return to Novice Elreth.

6401.name: Kaya's Alive
objective: Tell Tammra Windfield in Sun Rock Retreat the good news.

6402.name: Stormwind Rendezvous
objective: Travel to Stormwind City and venture to the city gates. Speak with Squire Rowe so that he may let Marshal Windsor know that you have arrived.

6403.name: The Great Masquerade
objective: Follow Reginald Windsor through Stormwind. Protect him from harm!
Speak to Squire Rowe if you need to contact Reginald Windsor again.

6421.name: Boulderslide Ravine
objective: Explore deep into the cave at Boulderslide Ravine and bring back 10 Resonite Crystals for Mor'rogal at Sun Rock Retreat to investigate.

6441.name: Satyr Horns
objective: Collect 16 Satyr Horns for Pixel in Splintertree Post.

6442.name: Naga at the Zoram Strand
objective: Bring 20 Wrathtail Heads to Marukai along the Zoram Strand.

6461.name: Blood Feeders
objective: Xen'zilla at Malaka'Jin needs you to kill 10 Deepmoss Creepers and 7 Deepmoss Venomspitters.

6462.name: Troll Charm
objective: Bring 8 Troll Charms to Mitsuwa at the Zoram'gar Outpost.

6481.name: Earthen Arise
objective: Open the Resonite cask with the Enchanted Resonite Crystal, and then slay Goggeroc. Return to Mor'rogal with the news and Enchanted Resonite Crystal.

6482.name: Freedom to Ruul
objective: Escort Ruul, then speak with Yama Snowhoof in Spintertree Post.

6501.name: The Dragon's Eye
objective: You must search the world for a being capable of restoring the power to the Fragment of the Dragon's Eye. The only information you possess about such a being is that they exist.

6502.name: Drakefire Amulet
objective: You must retrieve the Blood of the Black Dragon Champion from General Drakkisath.
Drakkisath can be found in his throne room behind the Halls of Ascension in Blackrock Spire.

6503.name: Ashenvale Outrunners
objective: Kill 9 Ashenvale Outrunners, then return to Kuray'bin at Splintertree Outpost.

6504.name: The Lost Pages
objective: Find the 12 missing pages of the Shredder Operating Manual, and put them together to form Chapters 1, 2, and 3. Return the pages to Gurda Ragescar near Splintertree Post.

6521.name: An Unholy Alliance
objective: Bring Ambassador Malcin's Head to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6522.name: An Unholy Alliance
objective: Take the Small Scroll to Varimathras in the Undercity.

6523.name: Protect Kaya
objective: Escort Kaya Flathoof to Camp Aparaje, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6541.name: Report to Kadrak
objective: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

6542.name: Report to Kadrak
objective: Report to Kadrak at the watch tower in northern Barrens.

6543.name: The Warsong Reports
objective: Open the Bundle of Reports.  Take the Warsong Reports to the Warsong Scout, Warsong Runner, and Warsong Outrider. Bring back the updates they give you to Kadrak at the northern watch tower in the barrens.

6544.name: Torek's Assault
objective: Escort Torek on his attack against Silverwing Outpost and Duriel Moonfire, then report to Ertog Ragetusk at Splintertree Post.

6548.name: Avenge My Village
objective: Kill 8 Grimtotem Ruffians and 6 Grimtotem Mercenaries, and then return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

6561.name: Blackfathom Villainy
objective: Bring the head of Twilight Lord Kelris to Bashana Runetotem in Thunder Bluff.

6562.name: Trouble in the Deeps
objective: Speak to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6563.name: The Essence of Aku'Mai
objective: Bring 20 Sapphires of Aku'Mai to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6564.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
objective: Bring the Damp Note to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6565.name: Allegiance to the Old Gods
objective: Kill Lorgus Jett in Blackfathom Deeps and then return to Je'neu Sancrea in Ashenvale.

6566.name: What the Wind Carries
objective: Listen to Thrall.

6567.name: The Champion of the Horde
objective: Seek out Rexxar. The Warchief has instructed you as to his whereabouts. Search the paths of Desolace, between the Stonetalon Mountains and Feralas.

6568.name: The Testament of Rexxar
objective: Deliver Rexxar's Testament to Myranda the Hag in the Western Plaguelands.

6569.name: Oculus Illusions
objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and collect 20 Black Dragonspawn Eyes. Return to Myranda the Hag when the task is complete.

6570.name: Emberstrife
objective: Travel to the Wyrmbog in Dustwallow Marsh and seek out Emberstrife's Den. Once inside, wear the Amulet of Draconic Subversion and speak with Emberstrife.

6571.name: Warsong Supplies
objective: Collect the Warsong Supplies: Warsong Saw Blades, Logging Rope, Warsong Oil, and the Warsong Axe Shipment for Locke Okarr in Splintertree Post.

6582.name: The Test of Skulls, Scryer
objective: You must find the blue dragonflight drake champion, Scryer, and slay him. Pry his skull from his corpse and return it to Emberstrife.
You know that Scryer can be found in Winterspring.

6583.name: The Test of Skulls, Somnus
objective: Destroy the drake champion of the Green Flight, Somnus. Take his skull and return it to Emberstrife.

6584.name: The Test of Skulls, Chronalis
objective: Guarding the Caverns of Time in the Tanaris Desert is Chronalis, child of Nozdormu. Destroy him and return his skull to Emberstrife.

6585.name: The Test of Skulls, Axtroz
objective: Travel to Grim Batol and track down Axtroz, drake champion of the Red Flight. Destroy him and take his skull. Return the skull to Emberstrife.

6601.name: Ascension...
objective: It would appear as if the charade is over. You know that the Amulet of Draconic Subversion that Myranda the Hag created for you will not function inside Blackrock Spire. Perhaps you should find Rexxar and explain your predicament. Show him the Dull Drakefire Amulet. Hopefully he will know what to do next.

6602.name: Blood of the Black Dragon Champion
objective: Travel to Blackrock Spire and slay General Drakkisath. Gather his blood and return it to Rexxar.

6603.name: Trouble in Winterspring!
objective: Find Donova Snowden near the hot springs in Winterspring.

6604.name: Enraged Wildkin
objective: Speak with Jaron Stoneshaper at Starfall Village.

6605.name: A Strange One
objective: Speak with Winna Hazzard in Felwood.

6607.name: Nat Pagle, Angler Extreme
objective: Nat Pagle wants you to catch the following fish:
Misty Reed Mahi Mahi from the Misty Reed Strand in the Swamp of Sorrows.
A Sar'theris Striker from the Sar'theris Strand in Desolace.
Feralas Ahi from the Verdantis River of Feralas.
Savage Coast Blue Sailfin from the Savage Coast of Stranglethorn Vale.
Return to Nat Pagle when you have reeled them all in!

6608.name: You Too Good.
objective: You think Lumak is trying to tell you that he can no longer help you improve your fishing skill. You may want to try to find his friend, Nat Pagle, a human fishing off one of the islands south of Theramore (at least that's what you think Lumak said).

6609.name: I Got Nothin' Left!
objective: Travel to Kalimdor, to the coastal city of Theramore. From there you must search for an island, south of the main town. Nat Pagle awaits your arrival!

6610.name: Clamlette Surprise
objective: Dirge Quikcleave wants you to get the following items:
12 Giant Eggs. You will find those on the Rocs wandering Tanaris or any other species of large bird.
10 pieces of Zesty Clam Meat. You can find those in clams, naturally!
20 pieces of Alterac Swiss. Get thee to a cheesery!
Gather all of the items and return to Dirge.

6611.name: To Gadgetzan You Go!
objective: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

6612.name: I Know A Guy...
objective: Travel to Gadgetzan in the Tanaris desert and speak with Dirge Quikcleave about advancing your cooking career.

6621.name: King of the Foulweald
objective: Place Karang's Banner on the Foulweald Totem Mound.  Do not let the furbolgs destroy the banner.  Defeat Chief Murgut and bring Murgut's Totem to Karang Amakkar at Zoram'gar.

6622.name: Triage
objective: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

6623.name: Horde Trauma
objective: Travel to Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands and speak with Doctor Gregory Victor about joining the ranks of Horde Trauma.

6624.name: Triage
objective: Save patients by using Triage Bandages to tend to their wounds. You must save 15 patients before 6 of them die from their injuries.

Remember the order of triage! Critically Injured Soldiers die the fastest followed by Badly Injured Soldiers. Injured Soldiers take the longest to die and should be saved AFTER your Critically Injured and Badly Injured Soldiers have been triaged.

6625.name: Alliance Trauma
objective: Travel to Theramore in the Dustwallow Marsh and speak with Doctor Gustaf VanHowzen about joining the ranks of Alliance Trauma.

6626.name: A Host of Evil
objective: Kill 8 Razorfen Battleguard, 8 Razorfen Thornweavers, and 8 Death's Head Cultists and return to Myriam Moonsinger near the entrance to Razorfen Downs.

6627.name: Test of Lore
objective: Answer Braug Dimspirit's question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in Stonetalon Mountains when you are ready.

6628.name: Test of Lore
objective: Answer Parqual Fintallas' question successfully and then speak to him again. He will remain in the Undercity until you are ready.

6629.name: Kill Grundig Darkcloud
objective: Kill Grundig Darkcloud and 6 Grimtotem Brutes, and return to Makaba Flathoof near the southeastern edge of Stonetalon.

objective: Keep Muglash safe as he travels to the brazier. Help him by putting the brazier out, then protect him as you fight against the Naga.
If you are successful, return to the Zoram'gar Outpost and inform the Warsong Runner of the death of Vorsha the Lasher.

6661.name: Deeprun Rat Roundup
objective: Capture 5 Deeprun Rats by using the Rat Catcher's Flute. Lead the rats back to Monty. Don't forget to turn in the flute when you're finished.

6662.name: Me Brother, Nipsy
objective: Take the Carton of Mystery Meat to Nipsy at the Stormwind Deeprun Tram Depot.

6681.name: The Manor, Ravenholdt
objective: Take the Seal of Ravenholdt to Fahrad at Ravenholdt Manor, hidden away in the hills of Hillsbrad.
Your cunning will be tested along the way. Be prepared.

6721.name: The Hunter's Path
objective: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6722.name: The Hunter's Path
objective: Speak with Dazalar in Dolanaar.

6761.name: The New Frontier
objective: Speak with Mathrengyl Bearwalker at the Cenarion Enclave of Darnassus.

objective: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.  Moonglade lies between Felwood and Winterspring, accessible through a path out of Timbermaw Hold.

objective: Use the Aspect of Neptulon on poisoned elementals of Eastern Plaguelands.  Bring 12 Discordant Bracers and the Aspect of Neptulon to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6805.name: Stormers and Rumblers
objective: Kill 15 Dust Stormers and 15 Desert Rumbers and then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6821.name: Eye of the Emberseer
objective: Bring the Eye of the Emberseer to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6822.name: The Molten Core
objective: Kill 1 Fire Lord, 1 Molten Giant, 1 Ancient Core Hound and 1 Lava Surger, then return to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6823.name: Agent of Hydraxis
objective: Earn an Honored faction with the Hydraxian Waterlords, then talk to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6824.name: Hands of the Enemy
objective: Bring the Hands of Lucifron, Sulfuron, Gehennas and Shazzrah to Duke Hydraxis in Azshara.

6844.name: Umber, Archivist
objective: Take the Encrusted Silithid Object to Umber - the Cenarion Circle's archivist - in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6845.name: Uncovering Past Secrets
objective: Speak with Rabine Saturna in the village of Nighthaven, Moonglade.

6921.name: Amongst the Ruins
objective: Bring the Fathom Core to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

6922.name: Baron Aquanis
objective: Bring the Strange Water Globe to Je'neu Sancrea at Zoram'gar Outpost, Ashenvale.

6981.name: The Glowing Shard
objective: Travel to Ratchet to find someone that can tell you more about the glowing shard.
Then, deliver the shard as you are directed.

7003.name: Zapped Giants
objective: Use Zorbin's Ultra-Shrinker to zap any kind of giant found in Feralas into a more manageable form. Bring 15 Miniaturization Residues found on the zapped versions of these giants to Zorbin Fandazzle at the docks of the Forgotten Coast, Feralas.

7028.name: Twisted Evils
objective: Collect 25 Theradric Crystal Carvings for Willow in Desolace.

7029.name: Vyletongue Corruption
objective: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Vark Battlescar in Shadowprey Village.

7041.name: Vyletongue Corruption
objective: Fill the Coated Cerulean Vial at the orange crystal pool in Maraudon.
Use the Filled Cerulean Vial on the Vylestem Vines to force the corrupted Noxxious Scion to emerge.
Heal 8 plants by killing these Noxxious Scion, then return to Talendria in Nijel's Point.

7044.name: Legends of Maraudon
objective: Recover the two parts of the Scepter of Celebras: the Celebrian Rod and the Celebrian Diamond.
Find a way to speak with Celebras.

7046.name: The Scepter of Celebras
objective: Assist Celebras the Redeemed while he creates the Scepter of Celebras.
Speak with him when the ritual is complete.

7064.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
objective: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Selendra near Shadowprey Village in Desolace.

7065.name: Corruption of Earth and Seed
objective: Slay Princess Theradras and return to Keeper Marandis at Nijel's Point in Desolace.

7066.name: Seed of Life
objective: Seek out Remulos in Moonglade and give him the Seed of Life.

7067.name: The Pariah's Instructions
objective: Read the Pariah's Instructions. Afterwards, obtain the Amulet of Union from Maraudon and return it to the Centaur Pariah in southern Desolace.

7068.name: Shadowshard Fragments
objective: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Uthel'nay in Orgrimmar.

7070.name: Shadowshard Fragments
objective: Collect 10 Shadowshard Fragments from Maraudon and return them to Archmage Tervosh in Theramore on the coast of Dustwallow Marsh.

7081.name: Alterac Valley Graveyards
objective: Assault a graveyard, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7082.name: The Graveyards of Alterac
objective: Assault a graveyard, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7101.name: Towers and Bunkers
objective: Capture an enemy tower, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7102.name: Towers and Bunkers
objective: Destroy the banner at an enemy tower or bunker, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7121.name: The Quartermaster
objective: Speak with the Stormpike Quartermaster.

7122.name: Capture a Mine
objective: Capture a mine that the Stormpike does not control, then return to Sergeant Durgen Stormpike in the Alterac Mountains.

7123.name: Speak with our Quartermaster
objective: Speak with the Frostwolf Quartermaster.

7124.name: Capture a Mine
objective: Capture a mine, then return to Corporal Teeka Bloodsnarl in the Alterac Mountains.

7141.name: The Battle of Alterac
objective: Enter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the Alterac Mountains.

7142.name: The Battle for Alterac
objective: Enter Alterac Valley and defeat the dwarven general, Vanndar Stormpike.  Then, return to Voggah Deathgrip in the Alterac Mountains.

7161.name: Proving Grounds
objective: Travel to the Wildpaw cavern located southeast of the main base in Alterac Valley and find the Frostwolf Banner. Return the Frostwolf Banner to Warmaster Laggrond.

7162.name: Proving Grounds
objective: Travel to the Icewing Caverns located southwest of Dun Baldar in Alterac Valley and recover the Stormpike Banner. Return the Stormpike Banner to Lieutenant Haggerdin in the Alterac Mountains.

7163.name: Rise and Be Recognized
objective: <Warmaster Laggrond salutes you.>
It is your time, <name>. You have done much for the Frostwolf Clan and in doing so, earned a place as not only a soldier of Frostwolf but also as a friend.
Well done! Present your initiate's insignia.

7164.name: Honored Amongst the Clan
objective: It is good to see you again, <class>. I had not expected you to return. Alas, you have proven yourself a brave and honorable soldier of the Frostwolf.
Your time has come again, <name>. You have earned a new ranking and as such, a new insignia denoting this rise in stature.
Present your insignia.

7165.name: Earned Reverence
objective: So many slain. Blood drenches the fields. Yet... You live... You have persevered. You have led our armies to many victories. For this, then, soldier, you have earned a new rank.
Present your insignia.

7166.name: Legendary Heroes
objective: Your radiate command and power, <class>. Exalted in the eyes of Frostwolf - the enemy cowers at the mention of your name.
Rise, Hero of Frostwolf. Rise and be honored!
Present your insignia.

7167.name: The Eye of Command
objective: Drek'Thar sings your praises. Kalimdor is abuzz with tales of your heroics. The Warchief glows - your stalwart defense of our clan has pleased him greatly.
You have earned the Eye of Command.
Present your insignia, Commander <name>.

7168.name: Rise and Be Recognized
objective: Most do not live long enough to rise above their own mediocrity. You have proven yourself to be an exemplary soldier, <class>. The time has come.
Present your insignia.

7169.name: Honored Amongst the Guard
objective: The base buzzes with news of your exploits in the Field of Strife! You have struck mighty blows against our enemy - crushing their morale! For this, you have earned a rank of honor among the Stormpike.
Present your insignia.

7170.name: Earned Reverence
objective: I must know, <name>. When you look directly into the eyes of the enemy, do you see fear? Do they now cower in your presence? They must realize that they are defeated!
You have earned reverence among the Guard. Present your insignia!

7171.name: Legendary Heroes
objective: Before me stands an exalted hero of the Alliance.
<Lieutenant Haggerdin salutes.>

Few have earned such a rank among the Stormpike. I have watched the enemy fall before you. I have seen their resolve crumble in your presence. When you enter the fray, you become the beacon of hope for our forces!
Present your insignia.

7172.name: The Eye of Command
objective: Let them hear your voice, Commander <name>! Let them know fear. Show them what power the Stormpike holds in their rank!
Present your insignia.

7201.name: The Last Element
objective: Travel to Blackrock Depths and recover 10 Essence of the Elements. Your first inclination is to search the golems and golem makers. You remember Vivian Lagrave also muttering something about elementals.

7223.name: Armor Scraps
objective: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Murgot Deepforge in Dun Baldar.

7224.name: Enemy Booty
objective: Bring 20 Armor Scraps to Smith Regzar in Frostwolf Village.

7241.name: In Defense of Frostwolf
objective: Venture to Alterac Valley, located in the Alterac Mountains. Find and speak with Warmaster Laggrond - who stands outside the tunnel entrance - to begin your career as a soldier of Frostwolf. You will find Alterac Valley north of Tarren Mill at the base of the Alterac Mountains.

7261.name: The Sovereign Imperative
objective: Travel to Alterac Valley in the Hillsbrad Foothills. Outside of the entrance tunnel, find and speak with Lieutenant Haggerdin.
For the glory of Bronzebeard!

7281.name: Brotherly Love
objective: Travel into Stormpike territory and slay Commander Karl Philips. Return to Commander Louis Philips when the task is complete.

7282.name: Brotherly Love
objective: Travel into Frostwolf territory and slay Commander Louis Philips. Return to Commander Karl Philips when the task is complete.

7301.name: Fallen Sky Lords
objective: Travel to Frostwolf territory and search for Wing Commander Slidore, Wing Commander Vipore, and Wing Commander Ichman. Return to Commander Duffy should you complete your mission.

7302.name: Fallen Sky Lords
objective: Find out what became of Wing Commander Guse, Wing Commander Jeztor, and Wing Commander Mulverick. Return to Commander Mulfort should you complete your mission.

7321.name: Soothing Turtle Bisque
objective: Bring 10 pieces of Turtle Meat and some Soothing Spices to Christoph Jeffcoat in Tarren Mill.

7383.name: Crown of the Earth
objective: Fill the Amethyst Phial and bring it back to Corithras Moonrage in Dolanaar.

7441.name: Pusillin and the Elder Azj'Tordin
objective: Travel to Dire Maul and locate the Imp, Pusillin. Convince Pusillin to give you Azj'Tordin's Book of Incantations through any means necessary.
Return to Azj'Tordin at the Lariss Pavilion in Feralas should you recover the Book of Incantations.

7461.name: The Madness Within
objective: You must destroy the guardians surrounding the 5 Pylons that power the Prison of Immol'thar. Once the Pylons have powered down, the force field surrounding Immol'thar will have dissipated.
Enter the Prison of Immol'thar and eradicate the foul demon that stands at its heart. Finally, confront Prince Tortheldrin in Athenaeum.
Return to the Shen'dralar Ancient in the courtyard should you complete this quest.

7463.name: Arcane Refreshment
objective: Travel to the Warpwood Quarter of Dire Maul and slay the water elemental, Hydrospawn. Return to Lorekeeper Lydros in the Athenaeum with the Hydrospawn Essence.

7481.name: Elven Legends
objective: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Sage Korolusk at Camp Mojache with whatever information that you may find.

7482.name: Elven Legends
objective: Search Dire Maul for Telmius Dreamseeker. Report back to Scholar Runethorn at Feathermoon with whatever information that you may find.

7486.name: A Hero's Reward
objective: Claim your reward from Hydraxis' Coffer.

7488.name: Lethtendris's Web
objective: Bring Lethtendris' Web to Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

7489.name: Lethtendris's Web
objective: Bring Lethtendris's Web to Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

7490.name: Victory for the Horde
objective: Take the Head of Onyxia to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

7491.name: For All To See
objective: Seek out Overlord Runthak in the Valley of Strength.

7492.name: Camp Mojache
objective: Speak with Talo Thornhoof at Camp Mojache in Feralas.

7493.name: The Journey Has Just Begun
objective: A dragon slayer and a seasoned leatherworker? You do not cease to astonish, hero. I am humbled.
Please accept what I am about to teach you. This knowledge will prove to be invaluable if you are to destroy what remains of the Black Dragonflight.
Create the cloak from the scales of the brood mother. It will protect you and your allies against the incendiary breath of the Lord of Blackrock... Nefarian.

7494.name: Feathermoon Stronghold
objective: Speak with Latronicus Moonspear at the Feathermoon Stronghold in Feralas.

7495.name: Victory for the Alliance
objective: Take the Head of Onyxia to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

7496.name: Celebrating Good Times
objective: Seek out Major Mattingly in the Valley of Heroes.

objective: A dragon slayer and a seasoned leatherworker? You do not cease to astonish, hero. I am humbled.
Please accept what I am about to teach you. This knowledge will prove to be invaluable if you are to destroy what remains of the Black Dragonflight.
Create the cloak from the scales of the brood mother. It will protect you and your allies against the incendiary breath of the Lord of Blackrock... Nefarian.

7498.name: Garona: A Study on Stealth and Treachery
objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7499.name: Codex of Defense
objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7500.name: The Arcanist's Cookbook
objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7501.name: The Light and How To Swing It
objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7502.name: Harnessing Shadows
objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7503.name: The Greatest Race of Hunters
objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7505.name: Frost Shock and You
objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7506.name: The Emerald Dream...
objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7507.name: Nostro's Compendium
objective: Return Nostro's Compendium of Dragon Slaying to the Athenaeum.

7508.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
objective: Give the Dull and Flat Elven Blade to Lorekeeper Lydros.

7509.name: The Forging of Quel'Serrar
objective: You must get Onyxia to breathe fire on the Unfired Ancient Blade. Once this is done, pick up the now Heated Ancient Blade. Be warned, a Heated Ancient Blade will not remain heated forever - time is of the essence.
The last step before returning to me is to slay the beast and drive the Heated Ancient Blade into her corpse.
Do this and Quel'Serrar will be yours.

7541.name: Service to the Horde
objective: It will take time for our scholars to study the pendant you brought us.  But for your service to the Horde I would like to offer you a small token.
Thank you, <name>.  Your acts bring honor to you, and to us.

7562.name: Mor'zul Bloodbringer
objective: Speak with Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

7563.name: Rage of Blood
objective: Bring 30 bottles of Raging Beast's Blood to Mor'zul Bloodbringer in the Burning Steppes.

7564.name: Wildeyes
objective: Bring the Case of Blood to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7581.name: The Prison's Bindings
objective: Travel to Dire Maul in Feralas and recover 15 Satyr Blood from the Wildspawn Satyr that inhabit the Warpwood Quarter. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when this is done.

7582.name: The Prison's Casing
objective: Travel to Darkwhisper Gorge in Winterspring and recover 5 Tears of the Hederine from the Hederine demons that occupy the gorge. Return to Daio in the Tainted Scar when you have completed this task.

7583.name: Suppression
objective: Venture forth into the Tainted Scar and locate a Doomguard Commander.
Use the Glowing Crystal Prison on the Doomguard Commander. Be prepared for a ferocious onslaught of attacks, as the demon attempts to escape capture.
Should you succeed, return the Imprisoned Doomguard to Daio in the Tainted Scar.

7601.name: What Niby Commands
objective: Speak with Impsy in Felwood.

7602.name: Flawless Fel Essence
objective: Impsy in Felwood has asked that you bring him three Flawless Fel Essences originating from three distinct locations.

The Legashi Satyrs of Azshara hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Jaedenar Legionnaires of Jaedenar hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region. The Felguard Sentries of the Blasted Lands hold the Flawless Fel Essence of their region.
Recover the Flawless Fel Essences and return  to Impsy in Felwood.

7603.name: Kroshius' Infernal Core
objective: Search Shatter Scar Vale in Felwood for the remains of Kroshius. When you locate the remains, use the Fel Fire near them and await Kroshius' return. When the infernal has awoken, slay him and take from his corpse Kroshius' Infernal Core.
Return Kroshius' Infernal Core to Niby the Almighty in Felwood.

7604.name: A Binding Contract
objective: Turn the Thorium Brotherhood Contract in to Lokhtos Darkbargainer if you would like to receive the plans for Sulfuron.

7621.name: A Warning
objective: <class>, you are about to undergo a rigorous series of events which shall test all of your abilities.
I suggest that you listen to the story that I have to tell.
Be warned, you must complete this task alone. It is recommended that your allies remain at a distance. Interference by outside agents will result in a most severe punishment.
Destiny has led you and you alone here. Battle with honor. Harness the Light.

7622.name: The Balance of Light and Shadow
objective: Save 50 Peasants before 15 are slain. Speak with Eris Havenfire should you accomplish this task.
You may view the Death Post to view how many Peasants have been slain.

7623.name: Lord Banehollow
objective: Purchase Shadowy Potions from Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.
Use the potions to travel through Jaedenar, and speak with Lord Banehollow.

7624.name: Ulathek the Traitor
objective: Confront Ulathek, then bring The Traitor's Heart to Lord Banehollow in Jaedenar.

7625.name: Xorothian Stardust
objective: Purchase Xorothian Stardust from Ur'dan.  Bring it to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7626.name: Bell of Dethmoora
objective: Bring 10 Elixirs of Shadow Power to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7627.name: Wheel of the Black March
objective: Bring 6 Large Brilliant Shards and 25 Dark Iron Ore to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

7628.name: Doomsday Candle
objective: Bring 35 Black Dragonscales to Gorzeeki Wildeyes in the Burning Steppes.

7629.name: Imp Delivery
objective: Bring the Imp in a Jar to the alchemy lab in the Scholomance.  After the parchment is created, return the jar to Gorzeeki Wildeyes.

7630.name: Arcanite
objective: Bring 3 Arcanite Bars to Gorzeeki in the Burning Steppes.

7631.name: Dreadsteed of Xoroth
objective: Read Mor'zul's Instructions.  Summon a Xorothian Dreadsteed, defeat it, then bind its spirit to you.

7632.name: The Ancient Leaf
objective: Find the owner of the Ancient Petrified Leaf. Good luck, <name>; It's a big world.

7633.name: An Introduction
objective: Your diligence and integrity has been noted, <class>.

We are Ancients: Protectors of this once great forest. Our physical forms were destroyed 10,000 years ago when Archimonde and the Burning Legion marched upon Hyjal. Our spirits, however, remain intact.
There are tasks that we can offer. Tasks that if completed will open up the secrets of the Ancients to you.
Know this, should you complete these tasks, merely return to this rock and we shall answer the calling.

7634.name: Ancient Sinew Wrapped Lamina
objective: Hastat the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Blue Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Hastat in Felwood.

7635.name: A Proper String
objective: Stoma the Ancient has asked that you bring him a Mature Black Dragon Sinew. Should you find this sinew, return it to Stoma in Felwood.

7636.name: Stave of the Ancients
objective: You must find and destroy these four demonic corrupters:
Simone the Seductress.
Klinfran the Crazed.
Solenor the Slayer.
Artorius the Doombringer.
Destroy these creatures and return to Vartrus the Ancient in Felwood with their heads.
Refer to the Petrified Bark in your inventory for clues as to their whereabouts.
You MUST complete this task by yourself.

7637.name: Emphasis on Sacrifice
objective: Travel to Ironforge and get High Priest Rohan's Exorcism Censer.  You will need to make a donation of 150 gold in order to secure it.

7638.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
objective: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

7639.name: To Show Due Judgment
objective: Return the Exorcism Censer to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7640.name: Exorcising Terrordale
objective: Use the Exorcism Censer to drive out the spirits that torment Terrordale.  When you have slain 25 Terrordale Spirits, return to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7641.name: The Work of Grimand Elmore
objective: Speak with Grimand Elmore in Stormwind's Dwarven District.

7642.name: Collection of Goods
objective: Bring 40 Runecloth, 6 Arcanite Bars, 10 Arthas' Tears, 5 Stratholme Holy Water vials, and 150 gold to Grimand Elmore in the Dwarven District of Stormwind.

7643.name: Ancient Equine Spirit
objective: Acquire special horse feed used for feeding a spirit horse.  Merideth Carlson in Southshore apparently is the source for such food.

Travel to the Dire Maul dungeon in Feralas and slay Tendris Warpwood.  Doing so will free the Ancient Equine Spirit.  Feed it the special horse feed, thereby soothing the spirit.  Finally, give it the Arcanite Barding so it may bless it.

7644.name: Blessed Arcanite Barding
objective: Return with the Blessed Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7645.name: Manna-Enriched Horse Feed
objective: Retrieve 20 Enriched Manna Biscuits - the key ingredient in making Manna-Enriched Horse Feed - for Merideth Carlson at Southshore in the Hillsbrad Foothills.  The Argent Dawn is known as the sole purveyor of the biscuits.
You also need to give her 50 gold to soothe her ruffled sensibilities.

7646.name: The Divination Scryer
objective: Bring an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in the Cathedral District of Stormwind.

7647.name: Judgment and Redemption
objective: Use the Divination Scryer in the heart of the Great Ossuary's basement in the Scholomance.  Doing so will bring forth the spirits you must judge.  Defeating these spirits will summon forth Death Knight Darkreaver.  Defeat him and reclaim the lost soul of the fallen charger.
Give the Charger's Redeemed Soul and the Blessed Enchanted Barding to Darkreaver's Fallen Charger.

7648.name: Grimand's Finest Work
objective: Take the Arcanite Barding to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District for his inspection.

7649.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume I
objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7650.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume II
objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7651.name: Enchanted Thorium Platemail: Volume III
objective: Return the book to its rightful owners.

7652.name: A Blue Light Bargain
objective: Aright, mister, I got a hot deal for ya.
I'm lookin' to offload some of these here Imperial plate armor recipes and need someone willing to take on the burden. All I want in exchange is some thorium bars. Sound good?

7653.name: Imperial Plate Belt
objective: For the belt plans, I'll be needin' 20 thorium bars.

7654.name: Imperial Plate Boots
objective: For the boot plans, I'll be needin' 40 thorium bars. Yep, 40. Are you gonna cry? Would you like a hanky?
<Derotain laughs.>

7655.name: Imperial Plate Bracer
objective: For the bracer plans, I'll be needin' 20 thorium bars.
Are you alright, sonny? Yer getting' all red.

7656.name: Imperial Plate Chest
objective: For the chest piece plans, I'll be needin' 60 thorium bars.
Oh boy, there you go again. Are you gonna be runnin' to yer blue Gods, askin' why they have forsaken you?!? Toughen up, Nancy! Nobody ever said life's fair.

7657.name: Imperial Plate Helm
objective: Just hand over 50 thorium bars and the helm plans are yers.

7658.name: Imperial Plate Leggings
objective: Just hand over 60 thorium bars and the leg plans are yers.
I know, I'm driving you into bankruptcy! I've heard it all before so you can save your sob story, weakling.

7659.name: Imperial Plate Shoulders
objective: For the shoulder plans, I'll be needin' 20 thorium bars.

7667.name: Material Assistance
objective: If you are interested in helping Sagorne Crestrider in Orgrimmar's Valley of Wisdom, bring him an Azerothian Diamond and a Pristine Black Diamond.

7670.name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
objective: Speak with Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker in Stormwind's Cathedral District.

7701.name: WANTED: Overseer Maltorius
objective: Deep within the Slag Pit of the Cauldron, in the Searing Gorge, you will find the traitorous Dark Iron dwarf named Overseer Maltorius.
Slay Overseer Maltorius and take his head. Return the head to Lookout Captain Lolo Longstriker in the Searing Gorge for your reward.

7703.name: Unfinished Gordok Business
objective: Find the Gauntlet of Gordok Might and return it to Captain Kromcrush in Dire Maul.
According to Kromcrush, the "old timey story" says that Tortheldrin - a "creepy" elf who called himself a prince - stole it from one of the Gordok kings.

7721.name: Fuel for the Zapping
objective: Collect 10 Water Elemental Cores from the Sea Elementals and Sea Sprays along the Forgotten Coast of Feralas, and bring them back to Zorbin Fandazzle who is near the dock there.

7722.name: What the Flux?
objective: Somewhere in the Slag Pit of the Cauldron you will find the Secret Plans: Fiery Flux that Overseer Maltorius stole. Find those plans and return them to Master Smith Burninate in the Searing Gorge.

7723.name: Curse These Fat Fingers
objective: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Heavy War Golems.
The Heavy War Golems wander the areas surrounding the Cauldron in the Searing Gorge. When you've killed enough, return to Hansel in Searing Gorge.

7724.name: Fiery Menace!
objective: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Searing Lava Spiders in the Searing Gorge. You can find Searing Lava Spiders in the plateaus and lava pools of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Searing Lava Spiders.

7727.name: Incendosaurs? Whateverosaur is More Like It
objective: Hansel Heavyhands wants you to kill 20 Incendosaurs.
You will find Incendosaurs occupying the lava pools inside the Slag Pit. The Slag Pit can be found in the Cauldron of the Searing Gorge.
Return to Hansel Heavyhands in the Searing Gorge when you have killed enough Incendosaurs.

7728.name: STOLEN: Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass
objective: Find and return the Smithing Tuyere and Lookout's Spyglass to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge.

The only information you have about these items is the following: They were definitely stolen by Dark Iron dwarves. The Smithing Tuyere is a blacksmithing tool used by blacksmiths and the Lookout's Spyglass is an invaluable monitoring tool to lookouts.

7729.name: JOB OPPORTUNITY: Culling the Competition
objective: Slay 15 Dark Iron Taskmasters and 15 Dark Iron Slavers. Return to Taskmaster Scrange in the Searing Gorge once you have accomplished this task.

7730.name: Zukk'ash Infestation
objective: Bring 20 Zukk'ash Carapaces to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

7731.name: Stinglasher
objective: Defeat Stinglasher in the Writhing Deep, bringing its glands back to Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

7732.name: Zukk'ash Report
objective: Deliver the Camp Mojache Zukk'ash Report to Zilzibin Drumlore.  He resides in the Drag of Orgrimmar.

7733.name: Improved Quality
objective: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Pratt McGrubben at Feathermoon Stronghold, Feralas.

7734.name: Improved Quality
objective: Bring 10 Rage Scar Yeti Hides to Jangdor Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache, Feralas.

7761.name: Blackhand's Command
objective: That is one stupid orc. It would appear as if you need to find this brand and gain the Mark of Drakkisath in order to access the Orb of Command.
The letter indicates that General Drakkisath guards the brand. Perhaps you should investigate.

7781.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objective: Return the Head of Nefarian to Highlord Bolvar Fordragon in Stormwind.

7782.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objective: Venture to the Valley of Heroes in Stormwind City and speak with Field Marshal Afrasiabi.

7783.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objective: Return the Head of Nefarian to Thrall in Orgrimmar.

7784.name: The Lord of Blackrock
objective: Speak with High Overlord Saurfang in Orgrimmar. He stands waiting for you in the Valley of Strength.

7785.name: Examine the Vessel
objective: Examine the Vessel of Rebirth and return it to Highlord Demitrian.

7786.name: Thunderaan the Windseeker
objective: To free Thunderaan the Windseeker from his prison, you must present the right and left halves of the Bindings of the Windseeker, 10 bars of Elementium, and the Essence of the Firelord to Highlord Demitrian in Silithus.

7787.name: Rise, Thunderfury!
objective: Present the Dormant Wind Kissed Blade to Highlord Demitrian.

7790.name: River Ends
objective: Look for the cause of the Skyborne struggle along Thondroril River.

7791.name: A Donation of Wool
objective: We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Stormwind for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.
If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

7792.name: A Donation of Wool
objective: We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by Darnassus for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.
If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

7793.name: A Donation of Silk
objective: As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low.  Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community!  If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

7794.name: A Donation of Mageweave
objective: Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks!  By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal.  Such generosity would not go unnoticed by Stormwind, I assure you!
If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

7795.name: A Donation of Runecloth
objective: <name>, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive.  As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth.  We are in absolutely dire need of it, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past!
If you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare.  We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there.

7810.name: Arena Master
objective: Speak with Short John Mithril in the Stranglethorn Arena.

7815.name: Snapjaws, Mon!
objective: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Saltwater Snapjaw turtles. Return to him when you have completed this task.

7816.name: Gammerita, Mon!
objective: Katoom the Angler at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill Gammerita and retrieve Katoom's Best Lure from her corpse.
Katoom mentioned that Gammerita hangs out on the coast with the other turtles.
