7828.name: Stalking the Stalkers
objective: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 15 Silvermane Stalkers and 15 Silvermane Howlers. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the wolves hide in the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7829.name: Hunt the Savages
objective: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 20 Savage Owlbeasts. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Savage Owlbeasts occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7830.name: Avenging the Fallen
objective: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill a Razorbeak Skylord and retrieve its Skylord Plume. Return to him once the task is complete.
Markhor mentioned that the Razorbeak Skylord are a rare breed that tend to occupy the wilds of the Hinterlands.

7831.name: A Donation of Mageweave
objective: Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks!  By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal.  Such generosity would not go unnoticed by Orgrimmar, I assure you!
If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

7833.name: A Donation of Wool
objective: We are currently accepting donations for wool cloth.  A donation of sixty pieces of wool cloth will net you full recognition by the Darkspear Trolls for your generous actions.  Our stores are such on wool that we would only need sixty pieces from you total; we should be able to acquire enough from others in the realm to support our drive.
If you have the sixty pieces of wool cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

7834.name: A Donation of Silk
objective: As with most other fabrics, our stocks of silk are at an all-time low.  Our stores are such that we'd only need sixty pieces of silk from you total; we should be able to reach our goal with the support of others.

A benevolent gift such as silk, might I add, would certainly increase your local standing in the community!  If you have the sixty pieces of silk cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

7835.name: A Donation of Mageweave
objective: Mageweave is running low, and we could use your help to replenish our stocks!  By counting on the community as a whole, we would only need a donation of 60 pieces of mageweave cloth from you to enable us to reach our goal.  Such generosity would not go unnoticed by the Darkspear Trolls, I assure you!
If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.

7836.name: A Donation of Runecloth
objective: <name>, you've been a tremendous contributor to our cloth drive.  As we work hard to replenish our reserves, one form of cloth remains critically low - runecloth.  We are in absolutely dire need of it, and we hope that you will be able to help us as you have in the past!
If you are willing, please bring me what runecloth you can spare.  We'll initially accept a single donation of sixty, and then we'll go from there.

7839.name: Vilebranch Hooligans
objective: Smith Slagtree at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Slagtree's Lost Tools. Return to him once this task is complete.
You recall Smith Slagtree mentioning that the tools might be at one of the Vilebranch temples in the northeastern region of the Hinterlands. You should also check Skulk Rock.

7840.name: Lard Lost His Lunch
objective: Lard at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to find Lard's Lunch. Return to him when this task is complete.
Lard mentioned that he left it on the island to the north. Watch out for Vilebranch trolls.

7841.name: Message to the Wildhammer
objective: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to slaughter 15 Highvale Outrunners, 15 Highvale Scouts, 15 Highvale Marksman and 15 Highvale Rangers. Return to him when this task is complete.
You can find the Highvale high elves at the Quel'Danil Lodge in the northwestern region of the Hinterlands.

7842.name: Another Message to the Wildhammer
objective: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to bring him 10 Long Elegant Feathers from the gryphons that inhabit the Hinterlands. Return to him once this task is complete.
Gryphons are known to inhabit every region of the Hinterlands.

7843.name: The Final Message to the Wildhammer
objective: Otho Moji'ko at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to travel to Aerie Peak in the western region of the Hinterlands and place the Final Message to the Wildhammer by the well in the center of town. Return to him once this task is complete.
Beware of angry Wildhammer dwarves and unruly members of the Alliance.

7844.name: Cannibalistic Cousins
objective: Mystic Yayo'jin at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to kill 30 Vilebranch Scalpers and 15 Vilebranch Soothsayers. Return to her when this task is complete.
Yayo'jin indicated that these trolls could be found near the Shaol'watha and Agol'watha temples in the north by northeastern region of the Hinterlands.

7845.name: Kidnapped Elder Torntusk!
objective: Primal Torntusk at Raventusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to rescue her mate, Elder Torntusk, from Jintha'alor.
You have been told that he is being held prisoner atop Jintha'alor, the Vilebranch capital city located in the southern region of the Hinterlands.

7846.name: Recover the Key!
objective: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to kill Hitah'ya the Keeper to get the Shackle Key to his bindings. Return to Elder Torn'tusk when you have recovered the key.

7847.name: Return to Primal Torntusk
objective: Elder Torntusk at Jintha'alor wants you to return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village with news of his rescue.

7848.name: Attunement to the Core
objective: Venture to the Molten Core entry portal in Blackrock Depths and recover a Core Fragment. Return to Lothos Riftwaker in Blackrock Mountain when you have recovered the Core Fragment.

7849.name: Separation Anxiety
objective: Huntsman Markhor at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover his twin brother's remains. Find and return Huntsman Malkhor's Skull and Huntsman Malkhor's Bones to Huntsman Markhor.

Markhor mentioned that his brother's remains were fed to the oozes and wolves of the Vilebranch. He also mentioned that there is a refuse pit filled with oozes in Jintha'alor as well as a wolf den. Both of these places are near the top of the temple.

7850.name: Dark Vessels
objective: Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands wants you to recover 10 Vessels of Tainted Blood from Jintha'alor. Return to Primal Torntusk when this task is complete.

7861.name: WANTED: Vile Priestess Hexx and Her Minions
objective: You have been ordered to slay Vile Priestess Hexx and 20 Vilebranch Aman'zasi Guards. See Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands once this task is complete.
Vile Priestess Hexx and the Aman'zasi Guards can be found atop Jintha'alor in the Hinterlands.

7862.name: Job Opening: Guard Captain of Revantusk Village
objective: You have been tasked with the decimation of 20 Vilebranch Berserkers, 20 Vilebranch Shadow Hunters, 20 Vilebranch Blood Drinkers, and 20 Vilebranch Soul Eaters.
Should you complete this task, return to Primal Torntusk at Revantusk Village in the Hinterlands.

7863.name: Sentinel Basic Care Package
objective: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, <name>.  As a reward, please take this care package!  Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Warsong Gulch.

As you continue to prove yourself inside the Gulch, you'll find that these items will become available to you for purchase.  Rations become available when you are Friendly with us, and bandages when you are Honored.

objective: You've certainly begun to prove yourself to us, <name>.  As a reward, please take this care package!  Inside it you'll find rations and bandages that are usable only inside Warsong Gulch.

7877.name: The Treasure of the Shen'dralar
objective: Return to the Athenaeum and find the Treasure of the Shen'dralar. Claim your reward!

7962.name: Wabbit Pelts
objective: Bring 3 LeCrafty Rabbit Pelts to Jon LeCraft.

8041.name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
objective: Hail, <class>. I am Jin'rokh the Breaker, troll of Mugamba. We of the Zandalar tribe recognize your accomplishments. We salute your tenacity and strength of will.
Wear this talisman around your neck, <class>. Let the strength of Mount Mugamba flow through your being. Be empowered as you strike down our enemies!

8042.name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
objective: It is good to see you in good health, <name>. The glorious battles you have undertaken affect all life on this planet. Hakkar must never leave the confines of Zul'Gurub as the world will surely collapse beneath his immense hunger.
Give me your talisman and I shall amplify its strength. Use the Strength of Mugamba to punish our enemies!

8043.name: Strength of Mount Mugamba
objective: Master <name>, you return! Molthor has sent word of your deeds to the King. Your name is known even in the South Seas. Perhaps one day you will be a legendary <class> - a story for the ages.
Give me your talisman so that I may once more amplify its power.

8044.name: The Rage of Mugamba
objective: King Rastakhan sends his regards, Master <name>. Such an honor has never been given to one outside the Zandalar tribe.
Give me your talisman so that I may enhance it once more. Know that the Rage of Mugamba is now intrinsically connected to your very soul.

8045.name: The Heathen's Brand
objective: Know this, heathen: A catastrophe has brought us together. Your pagan ways are neither understood nor appreciated by Zandalar but we are a fair people. Wear this brand around your neck. It shall serve as both a warning to our enemies and a symbol of your friendship to Zandalar.
Continue to serve our people and I will amplify the power of the brand.

8046.name: The Heathen's Brand
objective: I may have been too hasty in my judgement, <class>. It seems as if your blind faith in this Light has some value after all.
Give me your brand and I shall amplify its power.

8047.name: The Heathen's Brand
objective: I must confess, I did not think you had the resolution to see this cause through, <class>. Zandalar now considers you an invaluable ally. Well done, indeed.
Give me your brand and I shall once more amplify its power.

8048.name: The Hero's Brand
objective: The King has acknowledged your existence, <class>. You are the first of your kind to be accepted by Rastakhan as a true ally of Zandalar.
You will be rewarded greatly for your efforts. Present your brand and I shall apply the final amplification.

8049.name: The Eye of Zuldazar
objective: Accept this talisman as a token of our appreciation, <class>.
The Eye of Zuldazar will grow in power as your bond with the trolls of Zandalar strengthens. Return to me periodically and I shall imbue the jewel.

8050.name: The Eye of Zuldazar
objective: Welcome <class>. The Eye of Zuldazar pulses with energy. You are ready to take the next step. Hand me the talisman and I shall perform the imbue.

8051.name: The Eye of Zuldazar
objective: Tales of your battles against the Gurubashi are whispered in the winds, <class>. Even royalty is beginning to talk of your deeds. It is rumored that King Rastakhan even mentioned you by name.
The time has come to imbue the Eye. Hand me the talisman and I shall perform the service.

8052.name: The All-Seeing Eye of Zuldazar
objective: If only we had ten-thousand more like you, <name>. The armies of Hakkar would be scattered to the wind in the blink of an eye.
Alas, the Eye is ready to realize its full potential. Give it to me.

8053.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Armguards
objective: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker Primal Hakkari Bindings.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.

8054.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Belt
objective: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Shawl.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.

8055.name: Paragons of Power: The Freethinker's Breastplate
objective: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Tabard.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.

8062.name: Paragons of Power: The Predator's Bracers

Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.

8063.name: Paragons of Power: The Madcap's Bracers
objective: Bring Falthir the Sightless a Primal Hakkari Armsplint.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Friendly with the Zandalar Tribe.
Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.

8064.name: Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Belt
objective: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Sash.  Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale. You must also be Honored with Zandalar.

8065.name: Paragons of Power: The Haruspex's Tunic
objective: Bring Maywiki of Zuldazar a Primal Hakkari Tabard.  Maywiki of Zuldazar is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale. You must also be Revered with Zandalar.

8066.name: Paragons of Power: The Predator's Belt
objective: Bring the following Paragons of Power from Zul'Gurub to Falthir the Sightless: A Primal Hakkari Shawl.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.
Falthir the Sightless is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.

8067.name: Paragons of Power: The Predator's Mantle

8069.name: Paragons of Power: The Illusionist's Robes

8078.name: Paragons of Power: The Vindicator's Belt
objective: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Girdle.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Honored with the Zandalar Tribe.

8079.name: Paragons of Power: The Vindicator's Breastplate
objective: Bring Jin'rokh the Breaker a Primal Hakkari Kossack.  You must also have a reputation equal to or greater than Revered with the Zandalar Tribe.
Jin'rokh the Breaker is located on Yojamba Isle, Stranglethorn Vale.

8101.name: The Pebble of Kajaro
objective: <race>, the pebble held within the frame of this talisman comes from Mount Kajaro in the South Seas. Mount Kajaro is an area plagued by volatility - marked by violent and oftentimes magical volcanic eruptions.
As your bond with the trolls of Zandalar grows, so too shall the power of this pebble. Harness the power of the pebble to strike down our enemies. Be like the mountain: Quick, explosive, deadly...

8102.name: The Pebble of Kajaro
objective: Welcome back, <class>. I can see that the pebble has seen much use. Many of our foes have fallen to your otherworldly abilities. Their suffering has been great. It is time that I enhance the power of the pebble. Give it to me.

8103.name: The Pebble of Kajaro
objective: Hakkari fear you, <name>. They speak of horrors they believed that only their faceless God could perpetrate. You have burned them with the force of Kajaro. They now know fear in two places.
It is time to further strengthen the pebble. Hand me the talisman.

8104.name: The Jewel of Kajaro
objective: Give me the talisman, <name>. I must show you something.

8105.name: The Battle for Arathi Basin!
objective: Assault the mine, the lumber mill, the blacksmith and the farm, then return to Field Marshal Oslight in Refuge Pointe.

8106.name: Kezan's Taint
objective: Accept this talisman, <class>. Accept it and use its power to strike down our mutual enemies.

Know that around your neck you carry a piece of history. Kezan was once a grand territory of the Zandalar Empire. Alas, the taint of goblin trade princes would force out my proud brothers and sisters.
Kezan is now home to the goblin capital of the Undermine; but know that before the taint, it held greatness. Still to this day Kezan is considered sacred land to my people.

8107.name: Kezan's Taint
objective: Honor is earned amongst the Zandalar trolls, <name>. With honor comes reward - friendship, alliance...
Hand me the talisman so that I may enhance its power.

8108.name: Kezan's Taint
objective: I am ready for you, <class>. Once more I will enhance your talisman. I only ask that you continue in your destruction of Hakkar and his minions.
Give me the talisman.

8109.name: Kezan's Unstoppable Taint
objective: Call forth your demons, <class>. Let them bask in the energy of Kezan's Taint. Command them on the field of battle! Decimate the enemy!
Yes... The time has come to apply the final enhancement to Kezan's Taint. Give me the talisman.

8110.name: Enchanted South Seas Kelp
objective: See this here seaweed, mon? It be from the South Seas. We just add a little mojo and a little magic and it takes on the properties most suited to its owner.
You a <class> so it be easy, mon. Just wrap it around your neck and think of nature or squirrels or whatever it be that you people like.

8111.name: Enchanted South Seas Kelp
objective: Hey mon! It be good to see you again. The tribe be talking about your killin' of the Hakkari and all that. Molthor gave me the word to be adding more mojo to your talisman. Just give it here and Maywiki make it better.

8112.name: Enchanted South Seas Kelp
objective: How be that talisman, mon? It look like it be time to add a little more magic and mojo to its leaves. It need a little bloom in its wilt. Give it here and Maywiki fix it right up.

8113.name: Pristine Enchanted South Seas Kelp
objective: <name>! It been a long time since I seen you. Did you know that King Rastakhan himself be givin' me the order to add the final bit of mojo and magic to your talisman? It be true, mon! I wouldn't have believed it had I not seen it with me own eyes. Give it here.

8114.name: Control Four Bases
objective: Enter Arathi Basin, capture and control four bases at the same time, and then return to Field Marshal Oslight at Refuge Pointe.

8115.name: Control Five Bases
objective: Control 5 bases in Arathi Basin at the same time, then return to Field Marshal Oslight at Refuge Pointe.

8116.name: Vision of Voodress
objective: You and Maywiki have something in common, mon. We both be <class>! Although, Maywiki is more of a mystic and you be more of a scrub. Still, we both know what the great spirits bring.
As a gift I give to you this orb to wear around your neck. Look deep inside and see the village of Voodress in the South Seas! Let it lift your spirits!

8117.name: Vision of Voodress
objective: Sha-mon! Maywiki make a joke!
<Maywiki laughs.>
So, you been using the spirits and elements against our enemies in Zul'Gurub, eh? Spirits be praised!
Maywiki gonna brighten your orb. Give it here, <name>.

8118.name: Vision of Voodress
objective: Good news, <name>. Molthor be singin' your praises lately. He say how you be turnin' into a real hero of Zandalar.
He also say for Maywiki to polish your orb some more! Give it here so Maywiki can brighten the vision.

8119.name: The Unmarred Vision of Voodress
objective: <Maywiki points to your talisman.>
Look at it, <name>! It's come alive. The spirits dance around the orb.
Give it to Maywiki so she can make one last adjustment.

8120.name: The Battle for Arathi Basin!
objective: Assault the Arathi Basin mine, lumber mill, blacksmith and stable, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.

8121.name: Take Four Bases
objective: Hold four bases at the same time in Arathi Basin, and then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.

8122.name: Take Five Bases
objective: Hold five bases in Arathi Basin at the same time, then return to Deathmaster Dwire in Hammerfall.

8141.name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
objective: You progress swiftly, young <class>. Perhaps it is time to initiate you into the Shera Ali'kh - Zandalari for Death's Hand. For thousands of years we have played the role of assassin for the Zandalar Empire. For too long we have sat idly, allowing the Hakkari to grow in strength. Once more we face Hakkar, but this time without the support of a united troll front. It is you and your allies who must assist in vanquishing the Blood God and his minions!
Wear this talisman and let it assist you in your journeys.

8142.name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
objective: I sense that you have dealt countless fatalities to the Hakkari, <name>. You carry the stink of their mojo.
I assume the Shadow talisman has assisted in the culling? Give it to me and allow me to enhance its power.

8143.name: Zandalarian Shadow Talisman
objective: Impressive, <name>. You have a gift for killing that I have not sensed in another in many years. Even Molthor is aware of the work that you have done for Zandalar. It is time to enhance your talisman further. Give it to me.

8144.name: Zandalarian Shadow Mastery Talisman
objective: It yearns to grow, <name>. The talisman has soaked in all that you have done. The thousands of troll corpses littering Zul'Gurub have fueled its power. Hand it to me and I shall make the final enhancement.

8145.name: The Maelstrom's Tendril
objective: Amongst the Zandalarians, the profession of <class> is revered. Our greatest hunters travel to the edge of the Maelstrom to prove their resolution.
From the heart of the sea they pull strands of kelp known as Maelstrom Tendrils. The kelp is then woven into a talisman that is enchanted to improve their accuracy and power.
I now grant you a single weaving of the Maelstrom's Tendril. As your bond with Zandalar grows, I shall weave more power into the talisman.

8146.name: The Maelstrom's Tendril
objective: Ah, <name>, it is good to smell you again.
You'll have to excuse my sense of humor. It can be most foul at times.
I sense that you have caused great anguish to our enemies. The forces of Hakkar cry out your name in anger. This is most excellent.
You have earned another weave on your talisman. Hand it to me.

8147.name: The Maelstrom's Tendril

If this is going to work, I'm going to need my scrying goggles, a five hundred pound chicken and volume II of "Draconic for Dummies." Not necessarily in that order.

The Old God has foreseen our arrival.  All hope is lost.  What difference could a mere mortal like you possibly make?

8742.name: The Might of Kalimdor
objective: A thousand years has passed and just as it was fated, one stands before me. One who shall lead their people to a new age.
The Old God trembles, <name>. Oh yes, it fears your faith. Shatter the prophecy of C'Thun.
It knows you come, champion - and with you comes the might of Kalimdor. You have only to let me know when you are prepared and I shall grant you the Scepter of the Shifting Sands.

8743.name: Bang a Gong!
objective: The Scarab Gong looms ominously before you. Steel yourself, <name>; for once the Scarab Gong is rung, the gates of Ahn'Qiraj will be opened.
From the slackened maw of the beast can only come chaos and destruction. Defend your people!

8745.name: Treasure of the Timeless One
objective: Greetings, champion. I am Jonathan, keeper of the sacred gong and eternal watcher of the Bronze Flight.
I have been empowered by the Timeless One himself to grant you an item of your choosing from his timeless treasure trove. May it aid you in your battles against C'Thun.

8747.name: The Path of the Protector
objective: Impressive, little one. You have gone through much trouble to gain the favor of the Bronze Flight. Your dedication is noted.
The signet ring of the defender will offer superior protection against the forces of evil.
Be warned, once you have chosen your path, you will have no recourse should you change your mind.

8748.name: The Path of the Protector

8749.name: The Path of the Protector

8750.name: The Path of the Protector

objective: Wait, wait, you said your name was <name>?

<name>! I am so glad to finally meet you. Someone delivered a package here addressed to you and assured me that you would eventually come to pick it up. I tried to tell them that we don't do that around here, but before I could get a word in, they were already gone!
Your timing is great, too. It was gonna be lumped up with all the other garbage that I toss into the sea nightly.
What? We all do it. Ugh, just take your package and go!

96383.name: Legacy Reward: Spectral Bear Cub
objective: Ah, the great <name> is back. Just as I expected.
Why might I, Wiley, the humble innkeeper, expect the arrival of a specific adventurer? Because whoever your secret admirer is still hasn't updated your delivery address!
No, no, don't say anything. We're all busy, I get it. Just make sure they get it sorted, alright?
Here's your package. I am pretty sure whatever is in it is alive. Or was? At this point, I don't care to find out. I will forever remember it as being both alive and dead.

If you have the sixty pieces of mageweave cloth on you and are ready to donate them, I'm able to take them from you now.
